items.text: 设置页改为自动保存：选择立即保存、文字输入防抖保存，并显示保存状态，失败保留草稿。
items.text_en: Settings now save automatically: selections save immediately, text saves after a debounce, save status is shown, and a failed save keeps your draft.

items.text: RunningHub 分为 AI 站与 CN 站并列，可分别开关、分别填 Key；关闭只停新调用，保留已有配置。
items.text_en: RunningHub now shows the AI and CN sites side by side with independent switches and keys; disabling only stops new calls and keeps existing settings.

items.text: 画布模型改为一个入口内选模型、平台与运行模式，支持按名称搜索，并显示真实模型 ID。
items.text_en: Canvas models now use one picker for model, platform, and run mode, with search by name and the real model ID shown.

items.text: 常用参数直接铺在参数面板上，冷门的高级参数收进齿轮入口。
items.text_en: Common parameters stay on the panel, while rare advanced parameters move into the gear entry.

items.text: Hypit 模型设置对所有项目统一生效；已提交的任务不受之后修改设置的影响。
items.text_en: Hypit model settings now apply to every project, and submitted tasks are unaffected by later setting changes.

items.text: Hypit 原生 Studio 内部同步工作台的浅色与深色主题。
items.text_en: The native Hypit Studio now follows the workbench light and dark themes.

items.text: 统一下拉、按钮与卡片的暖白与香槟金视觉，浅色和深色主题都更协调。
items.text_en: Unify warm-white and champagne-gold styling for menus, buttons and cards in both light and dark themes.

items.text: 设置导航固定显示画布模型、Hypit、平台连接、AI 应用、本地工作流与 CLI，去掉重复的返回入口。
items.text_en: Settings navigation always shows canvas models, Hypit, provider connections, AI apps, local workflows and CLI without duplicate back entries.

items.text: 软件名称更改为「老胡画梦枋」，安装与更新地址同步更新。
items.text_en: The product is renamed to Laohu Creative Studio, with install and update URLs updated accordingly.

items.text: 修复 RunningHub 两个站点的 Key 与工作流互相串用、互相覆盖的问题。
items.text_en: Fixed RunningHub sites mixing up or overwriting each other's keys and workflows.

items.text: 修复 Hypit 设置页隐藏平台与 CLI、侧栏点击被拦截的问题。
items.text_en: Fixed the Hypit settings page hiding providers and CLI and swallowing sidebar clicks.
